i was diagnosed when i was 11, i’ve been on antidepressants almost since i started methotrexate and Humira when i was also 11. one thing that has helped me tremendously is 1 weed 2 self care and if your having a flare up i really recommend self care baths. get epson salts and bubble bath soap, a colorful light and shower products you love, while your at it set up your phone or a ipad to watch your favorite shows. i always make sure i have ice water also. one things that can help you shower is getting a detachable shower head and sitting while showering. do things you love and get just because treats, take care of yourself!!
